name: threads-memory
description: Capture and recall developer context using a Threads backend.

commands.title: Threads: Resume Where I Left Off

threads.backendUrl.description: Base URL for the Threads backend API

threads.eventFlushIntervalMs.description: How often to flush queued events (milliseconds).

threads.resumeMode.description: Resume UX on workspace open (quiet shows indicators only; prompt shows a message).

threads.resumePrompt.description: Deprecated; use threads.resumeMode. If set, true behaves like 'prompt' and false like 'off'.

threads.autoCheckpoint.enabled.description: Automatically create non-disruptive checkpoints while you work.

threads.autoCheckpoint.intervalMinutes.description: Create a checkpoint if this many minutes have elapsed since the last checkpoint and enough activity has occurred.

threads.autoCheckpoint.idleMinutes.description: Create a checkpoint after this many minutes of inactivity (if enough activity occurred since the last checkpoint).

threads.autoCheckpoint.minMeaningfulScor.description: Minimum meaningful score since the last checkpoint to create a new one.

threads.autoCheckpoint.onShutdown.description: Create a final checkpoint when VS Code shuts down (if there is unsaved activity).

threads.autoCheckpoint.onBranchChange.description: Create a checkpoint when the active git branch changes (if there is unsaved activity).

threads.resume.longBreakHours.description: If the project hasn't been opened for this many hours, show a one-time resume prompt.

threads.startup.openSnapshotPanel.description: Optionally open the Threads snapshot panel on workspace open (can be disruptive).

threads.export.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to include in exports (Copy for LLM / context bundles).

threads.export.redactHomeDir.description: Redact your home directory from exported file paths (replaced with ~).

threads.export.includeFilePaths.description: Include file paths in exports (otherwise use file names only).

threads.export.includeTaskHistory.description: Include recent task context (best-effort) in exports.

threads.feedback.githubRepo.description: Optional: GitHub repo in the form owner/repo for opening a prefilled issue.

threads.privacy.notice.default: Threads records editor activity and file paths. No code is sent unless you export it.
threads.privacy.notice.markdownDescription: Threads records editor activity and file paths. No code is sent unless you export it.
